Telangana monsoon gains momentum, several districts record heavy rainfall

The southwest monsoon gained momentum in Telangana on Saturday, with several districts recording heavy rainfall. Mancherial's Kannepalli received the highest rainfall at 132.3 mm, while parts of Hyderabad and surrounding districts experienced moderate showers and overcast conditionsDownload Interactive Maps

BY TELANGANA TODAY
PUBLISHED DATE - 12 SEPTEMBER 2026, 01:53 PM

Hyderabad: The southwest monsoon gained momentum in Telangana, with several districts recording heavy rainfall since Saturday morning.

Meanwhile, Hyderabad and its surrounding districts also experienced a sudden change in weather, with moderate spells of rain and overcast skies.

Powered By VidCrunch
Powered by VidCrunch

Mancherial district recorded the highest rainfall in the state, with Kannepalli mandal receiving 132.3 mm of rainfall between 8.30 am and noon on Saturday, according to the Telangana State Development Planning Society (TSDPS).

Warangal’s Raiparthy mandal recorded 89.3 mm, while Rebbena in Kumuram Bheem Asifabad district received 73.5 mm and Kesamudram in Mahabubabad registered 71.5 mm of rainfall. Heavy spells were also recorded in Bheemini (68.5 mm) in Mancherial district and Kalleda (66.3 mm) in Warangal.

In the Hyderabad region, Medchal-Malkajgiri district recorded the highest rainfall, with Ghanpur (NTPC) in Ghatkesar mandal receiving 22.5 mm. Malkajgiri (9.8 mm) and Abdullapurmet (5.8 mm) also witnessed steady showers until Saturday afternoon.Download Interactive Maps
